metadata.title: Cybersecurity could be Anthropic's next big opportunity - MarketWatch

content.text:
17 hours ago
Cybersecurity could be Anthropic's next big opportunity
As AI capabilities rapidly improve, Anthropic has been partnering with select organizations to help them shore up their cybersecurity capabilities. In a Monday note, Evercore ISI analyst Peter Levine called Anthropic a "potential disruptor" across vulnerability discovery and code scanning.
The company's Claude Security product can continuously scan customers' codebases and write fixes, Anthropic said in its S-1, adding that cybersecurity is following a "similar curve" to the explosion of AI coding capabilities. The company also recently launched OSS Scanner, which extends vulnerability-discovery capabilities to open-source software repositories.
However, Levine believes that Anthropic could benefit large cybersecurity platforms like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks, acting more like a partner than a competitor and helping them consolidate market share.
